description: Describes how the very first game world/session is created in jCRPG, since there is no single fixed 'level 1' map: the world is procedurally generated at New Game time from a scenario's data files. This mirrors org.jcrpg.util.saveload.SaveLoadNewGame.newGame(), org.jcrpg.world.generator.WorldGenerator and org.jcrpg.game.scenario.Scenario.
bootSequence: 1. J3DCore starts a ScenarioLoader pointed at a scenario directory (default './scenario' relative dir, historically '../scenario/jclassicrpg') and lists available ScenarioDescriptions (scenario.properties: name/author/desc/version/seed).
2. User picks (or the default/only) ScenarioDescription; SaveLoadNewGame.newGame() is invoked with it plus CharacterCreationRules and chosen party members.
3. A new GameStateContainer is created; HashUtil.WORLD_RANDOM_SEED is set from desc.seed (0 by default); charCreationRules is attached.
4. An Engine (world clock/turn driver) is created, its Time is set to hour=12/day=0/year=0 (noon start), numberOfTurn=0, and run on its own thread.
5. gameState.onLoad() loads the Scenario itself: Scenario.load() reads worldparams.xml, ecology.xml and events.xml from the scenario directory.
6. WorldParamsConfigLoader parses worldparams.xml into a WorldParams object (see worldParamsSchema below).
7. WorldGenerator.generateWorld(new DefaultGenProgram(...)) procedurally builds the World (terrain/geography/political/economic layers) from those WorldParams.
8. A WorldOrbiterHandler is attached with a 'sun' (SimpleSun) and 'moon' (SimpleMoon) orbiter for day/night and lighting.
9. EcologyGenerator reads ecology.xml and populates the World with an Ecology (fauna/flora/humanoid population groups, settlements).

10. The starting position is chosen near world center (realSizeX/2, realSizeZ/2, offset by tunable xDiff/yDiff/zDiff) then snapped to the nearest RoadShrine along the road network (world.economyContainer.roadNetwork.shrines) so the party starts on a road.

11. A PartyInstance is created at that position and each selected PersistentMemberInstance (character) is added to it; GameLogic ties core/engine/world/ecology/party together and is stored on GameStateContainer.
12. Scenario.initiateScenario() plays the scenario's intro Event exactly once (tracked via ScenarioState flag Scenario.INTRO_PLAYED) unless already played or in a test session.
notes: UPDATE: the real scenario data files ARE present in this workspace, at media/ai/world/default_worldparams.xml and media/ai/ecology/default_ecology.xml (top-level 'media/' dir, sibling of jCRPG-engine/). See realDefaultWorldParams and realDefaultEcology below for their actual content.

Because generation is seeded (WorldParams.randomSeed / desc.seed), the web port can reproduce the same first world deterministically once a matching PRNG algorithm (org.jcrpg.util.HashUtil) is ported alongside these real params.

realDefaultWorldParams.name: default
realDefaultWorldParams.author: eburriel@yahoo.com
realDefaultWorldParams.crossCheck: sizeX=40,sizeY=2,sizeZ=40,magnification=40 exactly matches the mined save's realSizeX/Y/Z=1600/80/1600 in world_seed0_sample.json (40*40=1600, 2*40=80) — confirms this is the actual file used to generate that world.

realDefaultEcology.name: default
realDefaultEcology.author: eburriel@yahoo.com
realDefaultEcology.populationRuleShape: <population ref-animal-id=... ref-climat=Arctic|Continental|Desert|Tropical percentage-chance-of-appearance=0-100 min-in-group max-in-group max-in-world food-chain-position=HERBIVORE|PRIMARY_CARNIVORE|SECONDARY_CARNIVORE prefix-name=...>
realDefaultEcology.crossCheck: Observed settlement id prefixes in world_seed0_sample.json (populationHumanCommoners#, populationBoarmanTribe#) correspond directly to bestiary ids HUMANCOMMONERS/BOARMANTRIBE here — confirms this is the real ecology file used to generate that world.

defaultGameState.startPositionRule: world center (realSizeX/2, realSizeZ/2) offset by (xDiff=-15, yDiff=0, zDiff=66), then snapped to nearest RoadShrine on the road network

fields.magnification: int - world grid magnification factor applied to sizeX/Y/Z to get realSize
fields.sizeX: int - world width in magnification units
fields.sizeY: int - world height (vertical layers) in magnification units
fields.sizeZ: int - world depth in magnification units
fields.landDensity: int 0-100 - how dense land mass generation is
fields.randomSeed: int - world generation seed, 0 by default
fields.climates: string[] - climate belt keys listed north-to-south, one of: arctic, continental, desert, tropical, generic
fields.climateSizeMuls: int[] - relative size multiplier per climate band, parallel to climates[]
fields.foundationGeo: string - base geography key covering the whole world before overlays (e.g. Ocean)
fields.geos: string[] - geography keys to place, e.g. Plain, Forest, Mountain
fields.geoLikenessValues: int[] - likeliness weight per geos[] entry
fields.additionalGeoLikenessValues: int[] - likeliness weight per additionalGeos[] entry
fields.geoNormalSize: int - baseline patch size for a geography region

sampleSaves.meaning: party size 3, saved 2010.04.26 00:47, world random seed 0 (the engine's default/example seed)
